SessionManager - Class in com.example.campuseventdiscoverysystem.activities
SessionManager — Singleton Production-level inactivity session timeout: • Warn user at 15 minutes of inactivity (via BaseSessionActivity dialog) • Hard auto-logout at 20 minutes of inactivity • Timer resets on every user interaction (tap, scroll, key press) • Persistent across app restarts via SharedPreferences Architecture: SessionManager stores the last-active timestamp in SharedPreferences.
SessionManager.SessionCallback - Interface in com.example.campuseventdiscoverysystem.activities
Implement this in BaseSessionActivity to receive warning / logout signals from the background timer without coupling SessionManager to any Activity class.
setCallback(SessionManager.SessionCallback) - Method in class com.example.campuseventdiscoverysystem.activities.SessionManager
BaseSessionActivity registers itself here in onResume().
